detail.longDescription:
BullStage: Cloud File Manager helps you keep your files organized, searchable, and easy to access from anywhere.

Upload files to your cloud space, browse folders, preview content, rename items, move files, and manage transfers with a clean, focused interface. Whether you are saving documents, images, videos, or everyday downloads, BullStage gives you a lightweight cloud drive experience built for quick access and simple organization.

The app also includes content search and trending discovery features, so you can move between cloud storage and fresh information without switching tools.
Key features:
	•	Upload and manage cloud files
	•	Browse folders and file lists
	•	Preview images, videos, and documents
	•	Search across saved content
	•	Rename, move, and organize files
	•	Track upload and download progress
	•	View storage usage and account status
	•	Discover trending content alongside your files

BullStage: Cloud File Manager is designed for users who want a practical cloud drive with fast search, simple file management, and a smooth everyday workflow.
